Product readiness gap: Product Sprint route and governed Studio handoff.
Broad early-stage weakness + low confidence: adaptive evidence request and no invented certainty.
Strong venture with distribution bottleneck: positive framing/root-cause hypothesis without PMF overdiagnosis.
Pre-Founder athlete/professional: principal-only record, Founder Readiness subtype, SPUR and no fabricated venture.
Regulated/red-flag: acuity override/referral and safe AI boundary.
Payment/Chart activation recovery: verified entitlement, same Chart and duplicate replay.
Active treatment -> Studio Sprint -> outcome -> Vault/Chart -> reassessment closed loop.
